feature: ADR-0111 generated queue delivery reservations preventing future tap identity aliasing
initial_failures: Existing 16384 single-slot single-batch pressure fixture hit new 4096-batch limit; regrouped 8 unique slots per batch to preserve isolated slot limit coverage. Full-queue fixture uses 4094 tap batches with one 2-action batch, preserving exact 4096 total batches and 8192 queued events.
abi: Pure Rust private delivery ledger/generated queue API; no unsafe/FFI/dependency/ABI change; oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: Shared engine changed; Windows native build and previous validations pending prior approval quota issue.

limitations: Delivery means removed from the stage queue, not actual binding execution or OS accepted output. Explicit retirement additionally requires caller to finish actual downstream bindings/scopes.
Active batch identities cannot accept new Down even when generated logical view is empty. Initial Down arrays share one saved device/source/Arc per batch; original saved Up retains old provenance.
At most 4096 unretired batches and 16384 delivery slots plus scoped snapshot reservations per queue; unified whole source subtree budget remains unfinished.
Control returns retain original logical slots/events semantics, not a complete actual owner cleanup inventory; actor must independently reconcile actual bindings and ledger.
Canceled/retired batch IDs must not be reused while external descendants/tasks remain; global batch allocator ownership remains caller responsibility.
Scope propagation, complete stage actor, branch/context and retained-old-parent child admission remain unfinished.
Pure shared tests and existing no-input process checks only; no real keyboard/devices/native duration/driver. UnsupportedActionTiming retained.
